Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.debug

Class Rewind

java.lang.Object
com.epitech.depthdiablo.debug.Rewind
All Implemented Interfaces:
DebugFeature
public final class Rewind extends Object implements DebugFeature
The R debug feature: holding R plays the last seconds backwards, like a video (GDD 1.1.2). It takes a photo of the world after every tick and, while R is held, puts the previous photo back on every tick instead of moving forward.

The photos live in a circular buffer created once (Q86): when it is full, the next photo overwrites the oldest one, so nothing is allocated during the game. After a rewind, the new photos overwrite the ones that were rewound past.

Pattern: Memento, the caretaker (Rewindable is the originator, StateBuffer the memento).
